gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-quicksand: Happy Monkey draws every stroke with a ruler-straight thickness and leaves wide gaps in its e, giving headings a bold, goofy swagger. Quicksand stays softer and taller, its lowercase bowls round like glass bulbs.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-akatab: Bold, uniform letters with no thick-thin shifts give Happy Monkey its blunt, distinctive face. Akatab follows with round shapes that look cupped rather than clenched, and that softness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-alan-sans: Happy Monkey looks like ink poured at a single width, bold and unmistakable, with wide gaps in its e. Alan Sans keeps the tails of its curves pulled back, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-albert-sans: Loud, blunt and a bit cheeky. Happy Monkey holds a ruler-straight line, while Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes, and that tension between shout and whisper is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-alef: Alef reads clean and modern, its open-ended curves letting text flow without any snagging or crowding. Next to it, Happy Monkey feels like a loud friend with zero modulation in the line, and the two make an amusing duo.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Happy Monkey is bold and distinctive, with crossbars as thick as its stems and wide gaps in the e. Alegreya Sans SC brings an open, welcoming gap in the c, and that warmth is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-almarai: Almarai is a clean, professional sans-serif with a line width that never swells or tapers, and its letters never pinch shut. But Happy Monkey up top is far louder, bold and ruler-straight, so a longer text feels like a calm reply to a shout.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-amarna: Happy Monkey is bold and distinctive, drawn with a ruler-straight line and wide gaps in the e. Amarna follows with contrast-free strokes and unclogged small counters, so the sans keeps text crisp under the heading's noise.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-andika: Andika has tails and terminals as thick as its main stems, and its s curves turn wide and easy. Andika also gives Happy Monkey's bold, ruler-straight display letters a friendly, approachable partner, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-anta: Wide gaps in the e make Happy Monkey instantly distinctive. Anta answers with gaping e shapes of its own and a wire-bent sign look at constant thickness, so the pair feels bold yet approachable in the same breath.
